title: 103 of the 110 changed skills fail S4 lint and tests on their reference checks, and 7 have no script contract tests
context: Following D-01M6CG6W9M6GN70AW52REH71SZ and D-01M6CYQ0JFG84Y6JXY78QBM485 (both draft/release bugs are fixed and pushed). S4 is not in the approved override list. A dry survey of all 110 changed skills: lint has no blocking finding in any of them. 103 fail the S4 reference checks: 152 files under references/ carry no 'verified: YYYY-MM-DD' line (97 skills fail on this alone), and 13 skills cite example paths that do not exist (vendor/, index/summary.md, registries/modules.md, journeys/ and others). 7 skills (expert-notes, check-tickets, discover, plan-sprint, post-tickets, refine-ticket, size-work) have scripts with no tests named '<script> <check>' for the 7 contract checks. Released so far (S4 green, in place, no tracked skill file changed): expert-need-detector, dashboard, join, onboard. skill-orchestrator and agent-orchestrator pass S4 but are held: their references describe draft and release, which this change alters, so documentation sync may edit them. acceptance-criteria-gen and expert-notes already hold S0/S1/S2/S5/S6 overrides and stopped at S4. Adding verified dates in bulk without checking each reference would claim a check that did not happen.
